lines.text: Nora planned her five-park road trip around one number: gas.
Then came entrance fees, campsites, a motel when it poured, and food in pricey park towns.
By day four, her budget was gone.
Before you book anything, cost out every day:
miles and fuel, entrance or pass, a bed, food, plus one spare line for surprises.
Visiting several parks this year? Compare an annual pass with single entry fees.
Save this while you plan your trip.
